scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install --omit=dev
scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
